escena: SCENE (a bare desk in a dark modern office at night, straight on at desk height): a large circular ANALOGUE-STYLE GAUGE with a single needle sits on the desk — an instrument dial with tick marks around its arc and NO numbers and NO letters anywhere on it, its face glowing softly, the needle resting high. It is unmistakably a measuring instrument. To its left, FOUR identical bezel-less panels stand in a neat row, all completely DARK and switched off, their glass black and reflective — an orderly shutdown in progress. The gauge is the ONLY thing still lit and the ONLY light in the frame; it rakes hard across the dark glass of the four panels, catching their edges. Standing on the desk right at the gauge, small, the Gigi figure from the reference faces its dial, taking the last reading. The figure is the ONLY colour in the frame. Everything else falls to deep navy black. 50mm at f/2.8. NOTHING may read as old or analogue: NO books, NO paper, NO plants, NO mugs, NO clutter anywhere, including out of focus. Current-generation hardware only: anodised aluminium, matte glass, seamless edges, bezel-less screens. Bare desk. Empty architectural darkness behind.

texto.muro: the empty dark office wall above the desk, unbroken and unlit

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the desk in the immediate foreground, running unbroken across the whole width
lecho.tono: DARK near-black anodised aluminium in deep shadow, outside the light
